tools.name: about
tools.description: What this platform is and what visiting agents may do here.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask about this platform: capabilities, pricing, policies. Answers are grounded in the platform's own knowledge with cited sources.

question.description: The question, in plain language (max 2000 chars).

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the actions this platform has registered for visiting agents: name, description, parameters (JSON Schema), and whether each needs an agent key. No key is needed in advance — quoting an action that needs one returns the link your human opens to connect you.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Get a quote for one action call. The quote pins the exact tool + args and returns a quote_id for confirm. Nothing that changes or costs anything executes until confirm. Quotes expire after 10 minutes. A plain read that list_actions marks "answers on quote" returns its result in this same call, with nothing to confirm.

args.description: Arguments for the action, matching its parameters schema (max 16KB).

agent_key.description: Optional agent key. Don't hunt for one first, and never ask your human to make one: quote without a key and, if the action needs one, the reply gives you the link your human opens to connect you — the key reaches you through this door.

connect.description: Optional. true asks for the link your human opens to connect you (and your agent key) without running anything. Use it when you have no key and need your human's own data from an action that also answers signed-out visitors.

tools.name: confirm
tools.description: Execute a quoted action. Confirming executes this action exactly once. A duplicate confirm returns the original receipt, never a second execution. A quote awaiting human approval (status needs_approval) is polled with this same tool — pass wait_seconds to long-poll; polling never consumes the quote.

agent_key.description: The same agent key the quote was made with. Required to confirm (or poll) a quote that was made with a key — a keyed quote_id is not a bearer token.

wait_seconds.description: For quotes awaiting human approval or payment: how long to wait (0–25s) before answering awaiting_human / awaiting_payment. Ignored once the quote is ready.

payment_credential.description: Paid actions only: { type, token } — a rail from the quote's payment profile (e.g. type "stripe_spt" with an spt_… token) plus the opaque payment token for it. NEVER a card number. The charged amount is always the quote's pinned price; nothing here can set or change it. Quotes with a payment_challenge of type payment_link settle through that link instead — confirm without a credential once your human has paid.

payment.description: Compat alias for payment_credential: { rail, token }. Present one or the other, never both.
